name: file-upload
title: 文件上传
description: 多文件选择与证件槽位，支持拖放、拍照、格式大小校验与受控上传状态，组件不发送请求。

files.content:
const DEFAULT_LABELS = {
  drop: "把文件拖到这里，或",
  choose: "选择文件",
  camera: "拍照",
  album: "从相册选择",
  pending: "待提交",
  uploading: "上传中",
  error: "上传失败",
  done: "已完成",
  remove: "删除 {name}",
  retry: "重试 {name}",
  replace: "重拍",
  delete: "删除",
  upload: "上传{label}",
  any: "任意格式",
  hint: "{accept} · 单个不超过 {size}",
  unlimited: "不限大小",
  typeError: "「{name}」格式不支持，请选择{accept}",
  sizeError: "「{name}」超过 {size}",
  countError: "最多可添加 {count} 个文件，超出的未添加",
}
type FileUploadLabels = typeof DEFAULT_LABELS
export { DEFAULT_LABELS }
export type { FileUploadLabels }
